params.command: $root='C:\\Users\\fengc\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\mods\\MHW-Manual-Mod-Manager-v8.8.13-win-x64'; $u=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'MhwModManager\Updater'; $o=[ordered]@{}; $o.Root=$root; foreach($f in @('build-identity.json','release-install.json','product-manifest.json')){ $p=Join-Path $root $f; if(Test-Path $p){ $o[$f]=Get-Content $p -Raw } else {$o[$f]='MISSING'} }; $p=Join-Path $u 'pending.json'; if(Test-Path $p){$o.Pending=Get-Content $p -Raw}else{$o.Pending='MISSING'}; $log=Join-Path $u 'updater.log'; if(Test-Path $log){$o.UpdaterLog=(Get-Content $log -Tail 120) -join [Environment]::NewLine}else{$o.UpdaterLog='MISSING'}; $o | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
